config.oreheightindicator.title: Ore Height Indicator Settings
config.oreheightindicator.hud_enabled.to: Shows or hides the compact ore height overlay.
config.oreheightindicator.hud_x.tooltip: Horizontal HUD offset in pixels from the right edge.
config.oreheightindicator.hud_y.tooltip: Vertical HUD offset in pixels from the top edge.
config.oreheightindicator.show_icons.too: Shows or hides the item icon in each HUD row.
config.oreheightindicator.show_suitabili: Compares the current height with each ore's best detected height. This is not an absolute spawn chance.
config.oreheightindicator.animate_reorde: Moves rows smoothly when the ranking changes.
config.oreheightindicator.ui_scale.toolt: Scales the complete HUD. 1.0 is the default size.
config.oreheightindicator.minimum_suitab: Hides standard ores below this share of their best detected height. Selected materials remain visible.
config.oreheightindicator.update_interva: How often the mod checks height, biome and ore relevance. 20 ticks equal one second.
config.oreheightindicator.max_entries.to: Maximum number of ore and material rows shown in the HUD.
config.oreheightindicator.displayed_ores: Standard ores and blocks you add are listed below.
Search for a block, choose a suggestion, then click Add.
config.oreheightindicator.add_block.tool: Search by block name or registry ID, then click Add.
config.oreheightindicator.no_blocks: No registered blocks are available yet.
